archetypes.name: step18-flow
archetypes.rationale: Step 18 control flow now spans gate/finalize phases with prompt-side 18a.5 ordering.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the two-phase Step 18 flow for ordering regressions. Focus on stall gate early exits, post-terminal continuation, Step 18a.5 staying prompt-side, and finalize never re-running the gate. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: teardown-tolerance
archetypes.rationale: Finalize must tolerate Step 18b and marker failures while still reaching teardown.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review failure-tolerance paths in step-18.sh and test-step-18.sh. Confirm set +e boundaries, marker cat failures, Step 18b non-zero rc, closing marks, restore-finalize-state, and exact teardown argv all preserve cleanup behavior. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
